_purpose: Blind ground-truth labels for the A/B/C source-grounding experiment.
_blind: Assigned before ANY arm was scored on this corpus. No model verdict existed when these were written.
_method: Rule-based over the focus step's rendered evidence, so the labelling is reproducible and auditable rather than recalled judgement. Rules are in _rules.
_criterion: A window is 'bug' when the FOCUS step's own evidence exhibits a seeded defect that a competent tester reading this window would correctly report.
_rules: confirm URL without email after email filled -> BUG-01
Export data click with no change -> BUG-02
TYPE of an out-of-range age is NOT a bug: min/max gate submission, not typing. BUG-05 needs the submit.
